Number(params.bounciness) : 1.25; const squashAmt = params.impactSquash !== undefined ? Number(params.impactSquash) : 0.45; const crushAmt = params.crushA !== undefined ? h : w) * 0.45 * crushAmt; const scaleA = 1 - crushProgress * 0.35 * crushAmt; const shakeA = impactSpike * (ctx.random(Math.floor(p * 45)) - 0.5) * 28 * bounceMult; if (isVert) { const anchorY = sign > 0 ? w : 0; g.translate(anchorX + pushOffset, h * 0.5 + shakeA); g.scale(Math.max(0.2, scaleA), 1 + crushProgress * 0.08 * crushAmt); g.drawImage(ctx.inputA, sign > 0 ? -w : 0, -h * 0.5, w, h); } if (shadowAmt > 0) { g.fillStyle = '#000000'; g.globalAlpha = Math.min(0.85, coverage * shadowAmt * 0.85); g.fillRect(-w, -h, w * 2, h * 2); } g.restore(); } const squashFactor = 1 - impactSpike * 0.16 * squashAmt; const stretchFactor = 1 / Math.max(0.65, squashFactor); const offsetMajor = -sign * bounceDist * (isVert ?
